CameraKey.description: Page viewport at a timeline frame: scroll in page px, zoom 1 = page width fits the region.
CameraKey.title: CameraKey

CaptureAsset.description: A capture the bundle carries: its manifest plus the page tiles the renderer draws.
CaptureAsset.title: CaptureAsset

CaptureQuote.description: A passage located in the capture; line_rects are page pixels, occurrence picks a repeat.
CaptureQuote.title: CaptureQuote

CaptureTile.description: One viewport-high PNG of the page at y_px; path is local until the renderer stages it.
CaptureTile.title: CaptureTile

Cue.description: A narration anchor: a token span of one segment, never a quoted phrase.
Cue.title: Cue

DatasetRow.description: One row; every quantitative cell must equal a claim value listed in claim_ids.
DatasetRow.title: DatasetRow

DiagramLayout.description: ELK output for one diagram scene, computed before rendering so every frame is pure.
DiagramLayout.title: DiagramLayout

Entity.description: A thing with persistent identity across scenes: same colour, label and place everywhere.
Entity.title: Entity

EntityBox.description: Where a text sits; text is what the compiler verified fits (a short_label when needed).
EntityBox.title: EntityBox

ExplainerTimeline.description: The explainer's compiled timeline: frames, geometry and colours resolved from the spec.
ExplainerTimeline.title: ExplainerTimeline

HighlightKey.description: A quote's overlay: lines sweep in over start..end, then stay until the clear fade, if any.
HighlightKey.title: HighlightKey

NarrationPause.description: Silence before a token (0: the whole take), so the voice waits for the picture.
NarrationPause.title: NarrationPause

Scene.description: One composition with one template, mutated by beats; a new question gets a new scene.
Scene.title: Scene

SeriesBinding.description: A series entity; value is the series_field value it draws, empty for a single series.
SeriesBinding.title: SeriesBinding

SourceCaptureManifest.description: A signed capture of one source with its sections and located quotes; rendering reads this.
SourceCaptureManifest.title: SourceCaptureManifest

VisualSpec.description: Typed semantic intent for every scene of one episode; nothing in it is renderer code.
VisualSpec.title: VisualSpec

description: Everything the renderer reads: spec, compiled timeline, data, layouts and captures.
title: ExplainerRenderBundle
